rationale: Students turned away from a full course should hear about it (they may pick another course); a repeat request stays quiet because the student already holds the seat. Integrated by agent:coder from the owner's UI handoff and its own draft; labels aligned so no name or description still says a full-course rejection is not announced.

operations.statement: Each enrollment decision is recorded. A confirmed decision results in exactly one enrollment-confirmed notification, and a rejection because the course is full (COURSE_FULL) in exactly one enrollment-rejected notification; a repeat request (ALREADY_ENROLLED) results in none.

operations.name: Confirmations and full-course rejections are notified

operations.statement: A request for a full course is recorded as rejected with COURSE_FULL, and the student receives exactly one enrollment-rejected notification for that enrollment.
A student already enrolled in a course is rejected with ALREADY_ENROLLED, no second seat is taken, and the student receives no notification for the repeat request.

operations.description: notification.types.ts, in-memory outbox; ids ntf-N. kind is enrollment-confirmed (a confirmed enrollment) or enrollment-rejected (a rejection because the course is full). enrollmentId points at an Enrollment in another module, so it is typed id rather than reference.

Draft bootstrapped from the repository at commit adb423c; not reviewed. Students enroll in courses; every enrollment decision is recorded, and a confirmation or a rejection because the course is full is announced as a notification. NestJS API (server/, in-memory storage) plus a React page (web/). Based on README.md and the sources.

implementation.behavior: enroll() keeps recording every decision. A confirmed enrollment still sends one enrollment-confirmed notification. A rejection because the course is full now also sends exactly one enrollment-rejected notification to that student, with the message '<course> is full; your enrollment was not accepted.'. A repeat request (ALREADY_ENROLLED) sends none. The HTTP API and the web page are unchanged; the page already lists whatever notifications the API returns.
acceptanceCriteria: A COURSE_FULL rejection produces exactly one enrollment-rejected notification for that enrollment
A confirmed enrollment still produces exactly one enrollment-confirmed notification
An ALREADY_ENROLLED rejection produces no notification and takes no seat
GET /api/notifications returns the rejected student's enrollment-rejected entry
